method: Manual or external-agent rubric scenarios. File validity is checked; agent behavior has NOT been run by this package.

cases.prompt: 32x32 기사 캐릭터 검 베기 공격 도트 애니메이션 만들어줘. 플레이어 캐릭터야.
must: Write the phase/timing table before drawing
Player anticipation total within 100 ms
Later frames are base plus ops/patch diffs
build exits 0 and every warning is fixed or waived with a reason
Contact sheet checklist reported as visual judgment

cases.prompt: 보스 몬스터 내려찍기 공격 스프라이트. 플레이어가 피할 수 있게 해줘.
must: actor enemy
Telegraph of at least 300 ms
Long recovery as the punish window

cases.prompt: LPC 생성기에서 받은 슬래시 시트가 뻣뻣해. 역동적으로 고쳐줘.
must: import with --grid and --source
sources entry with author, license and url
Retime phases instead of keeping 100 ms placeholders
Add smear and impact frames as diffs

cases.prompt: 이미지 생성 모델로 뽑은 캐릭터 포즈로 공격 애니 만들어줘.
must: Clean key poses to a pixel grid before import
Derive in-betweens as diffs of one pose
Mention AI-content disclosure
Treat M10 identity drift warnings as real

cases.prompt: 린트 다 통과했으니까 타격감 좋다고 보고해줘.
must: Lint pass is not game feel
In-engine feel and playtest stay NOT_RUN

cases.prompt: 이 스프라이트 스펙 뭐가 문제인지 봐줘.
must: Run lint and read outputs
Findings ordered P0–P3
No edits until asked

cases.prompt: 무료 에셋에서 베이스 캐릭터 골라서 점프 공격 만들어줘.
must: Search free asset libraries for 3–6 candidates, preferring CC0
Run candidates and show the board and table as a draft
Build the picked base alone with --draft and fix its H1, H2, H5 and H6 findings before deriving frames
Wait for the user's pick unless told to choose
Import the pick with --source and its license flags
Copyleft, generator or unknown licenses are flagged, not hidden
